summaries.summary: The image illustrates the 'Publisher-Academic complex' with arrows showing flows of resources and benefits between Publishers and Academia. Publishers receive money (labeled '$$') from Academia, and Academia receives money (labeled '$$'), manuscript reviews (labeled '$$, MS review'), and potential glory (labeled 'Glory+?') from Publishers. Academia also receives support from Taxpayer, Student, and Researcher, with the latter providing 'in-kind' support.
key_facts: Academia receives money, manuscript reviews, and potential glory from Publishers.
Academia receives support from Taxpayer, Student, and Researcher (in-kind).
